list: Official 55 PS5 trophies. Names, descriptions and grades as listed on Exophase and PSNProfiles (checked live 2026-11-20, 55/55 descriptions matched Exophase in order, 0 mismatches). 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. 0 online trophies — the whole set is single-player.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing else is needed: no multiplayer, no DLC, no online mode — PowerPyx confirms the whole set is single-player. Treat the roadmap as the plan: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the last strands and clean-up.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission of Chapter 1, so it unlocks naturally within the first hour; there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss. If you are following the roadmap, this is step one of twelve story trophies.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Play the story missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes (PowerPyx notes the chapter trophies can pop a little late, after the first mission or two of the next chapter, so do not worry if it does not fire at the cutscene). Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house — see Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: play through the story; the pop may lag a mission or two into Chapter 3. Chapter 2 is also when you can first roam with both characters, which opens Hot Together and Retail Therapy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep playing the story; the chapter trophy may pop shortly after Chapter 4 begins. Chapter 3 opens several strands (Andy, Randy, Tyrone) and the Snap Gun mission you need for Sneakthief — start them when they appear.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The longest chapter for side content: bank jobs open here through an optional mission, and three of the six tracked main-mission trophies sit in this chapter. Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter — missions cannot be replayed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Chapter 5. It is the only gold story trophy and it pops when the credits roll; after it, free roam continues and the 100% checklist unlocks under Progress, then Stats. Do not start a new game for anything: everything left can be finished in free roam.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. One of the six tracked main missions, in Chapter 2. Story missions cannot be replayed, but none of the story trophies can be missed — finish the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist, in Chapter 3. A story trophy: play the mission when it comes and it unlocks with it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play, in Chapter 4. Story trophy — it unlocks as you play the mission, no preparation needed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners, in Chapter 4. One of three tracked missions in Chapter 4; finish it and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, in Chapter 4. Story trophy, unlocked by finishing the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory, in Chapter 5. The last of the six tracked main missions before the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion (Push Square). PowerPyx calls the list lenient — closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 300 stunts. The only parts that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps — so you need a little over half; 100% completion needs 300. Stunts happen naturally while driving and flying; for the last stretch, work the stunt jumps you have not done yet, since each counts once.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything, so knock this out early in Chapters 1 and 2 as each activity appears.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges in total (PSNProfiles count), so every one needs gold — no skips. PowerPyx rates the golds as not too difficult. Practise a range until the gold line is comfortable, then move on; leave this for after the story, when you can revisit ranges freely.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in total. Drone races are one of the parts 100% completion needs in full, so a win everywhere serves two trophies. Learn each course once, then race it to win; you can retry a location as often as needed.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, off-road or otherwise. Enter races as you find them during the story and in free roam; the tracker counts distinct wins, so repeating the same race does not help.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you a fishing spot after you meet him in Chapter 1 (SixShore). Go to the spot, take the challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play one in-game video game through to the end. SixShore reports three games on the TV at home and a fourth on arcade machines. Pick the shortest, learn its loop, and finish a run; it also ticks one of the 9 activity types.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is Lucia-only and starts with a phone call in Chapter 3 (SixShore). Answer it when it comes, follow the strand to its last mission, and finish it. Reported, not yet confirmed in-game — the strand timing comes from SixShore's reading of the guides, so treat the chapter as a guide, not a guarantee.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is treasure diving across 7 shipwrecks (SixShore). He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so do not worry if he disappears — the strand is not missable. Work the wrecks when he is back and finish his last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand runs at the mud club in Kelly County and opens in Chapter 2 (SixShore). Head there when it unlocks, follow the strand through, and finish its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some side questlines count, and PowerPyx is still confirming which ones (SixShore). The strands can be done after the story, and Strangers & Freaks is not part of 100% completion, so leave it for step 3 of the roadmap: finish the character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus three more stranger strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a wish list of 16 sports cars and opens in Chapter 3 (SixShore). Collect the cars he asks for — scanning vehicles with WAiNK as you go helps Whip It Good too — then finish his last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is shutting down labs in Vice City, Jason-only, from Chapter 3 (SixShore). Take the strand when it opens, clear the labs, and finish its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations. This is the one possibly missable trophy: PowerPyx flags a first meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1, where Lucia meditates on the balcony one morning. Follow her and accept the optional quest — it takes a minute and removes the risk. PowerPyx notes it raises the meditation counter by one but is not marked as a spot like the other 18, so it is unclear whether the trophy needs it; PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked. Do the other 18 spots whenever you pass them.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is Jason-only, from Chapter 2 (SixShore). PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal triggers it; clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which 100% needs, should cover it. Study animals through the binoculars as you go — 100% needs 100 of 255 studied, and you do not have to hunt them.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18 in total. You only need 3 sets for the trophy, but 100% completion needs 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past the third set. Cards are found across Leonida; a set completes when you hold every card in it.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan spots with the WAiNK phone app — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count (SixShore). Scan everything you pass during the story; 100 scans is the trophy, and scanning vehicles the same way counts toward Whip It Good.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges out of 80. Any 50 count, so skip the ones you hate — 100% needs 70, which still leaves 10 you can skip. Challenges cover stunts, ranges, races and more, so this fills in as you chase the other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2 (SixShore). Bank jobs give 4 stars anyway, so the simplest route is a bank job with your partner, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. You need both characters roaming together, which starts after Chapter 2's Coffee Break mission (PowerPyx video guide). Hit 3 robbery targets in a row while the police chase you the whole time — green map icons mark the targets. PowerPyx notes the trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop, so keep driving and wait for it.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive them (SixShore). Scan every new vehicle you see; 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past the trophy.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. PowerPyx reports gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to. Find a gang fight, trigger Combat Focus with a group close together, and drop five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. SixShore's reading: steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away. Reported, not yet confirmed in-game — get to the airport, take a jet from a gate, and get it airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — steal a military tank. PowerPyx found tanks at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest (SixShore). Reported, not yet confirmed in-game: get to the air station, take a Rhino, and survive the response long enough for the pop.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you (SixShore). With it, get in and out of a jewelry store unseen — plan the approach, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 vaults in total and 100% completion needs all of them (SixShore). Five is the trophy — the other three are for the checklist. Escape clean after each vault: the trophy counts vaults robbed and escaped from.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or you can blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier (SixShore). Either way, take the cash and escape — losing the wanted level after the robbery is part of the job.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. SixShore's advice: a plane is fastest. Fly a grid over the state until no fog is left; driving the roads works too but takes far longer.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs. One operation per gang is the trophy; 100% completion needs all 39 operations (SixShore). Work through the gangs one by one and the trophy pops with the ninth.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The method is not yet confirmed by any guide we cite (SixShore, PowerPyx) — the description is the whole brief: get to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and have a cocktail. Treat this as from-the-description-only until a guide pins it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No guide we cite has confirmed the exact method yet (SixShore, PowerPyx): the description is the brief — get into a vehicle showroom and leave through the front in the loudest way possible. From the official description only, for now.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. SixShore's reading: take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn — and the robbery comes back later, so it is not missable. Reported, not yet confirmed in-game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — max out strength on both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress (SixShore). One note on the record: Push Square does not mark this trophy hidden, while the other trackers count it among the 28 hidden — the method is the same either way.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — do 500 things that change your criminal profile. It comes naturally (SixShore); PSN tracks the count to 500. Play normally, make choices, and check Progress to see the count climb. Nothing special to do.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Not yet confirmed — PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store (SixShore). From the official description only: something you fail once and get right the second time. We will not invent the trigger; check the sources for updates.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Not yet confirmed — PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline (SixShore). From the official description only: keep an eye out for the strange while exploring Leonida, and check the cited guides as they update.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Not yet confirmed — the in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle (SixShore). From the official description only: try a melee strike from a moving bike once you are rolling.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder through fences; it adds up across robberies (SixShore). The dye pack jammer you need unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission, so this starts in Chapter 3 at the earliest. Bank vaults are the best late-game earner (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest (SixShore). It counts across all shops and adds up over the whole game, so just play and buy what you need — it pops on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. PowerPyx puts the combined price at $160,000, and the real estate app arrives in Chapter 2 (SixShore). Buy them as you can afford them; garage space is also what On the Spot needs.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes (SixShore). Park vehicles you own in your garages and register them in the app until you hit 10.
